resources.string: "VisionPsy-Nano on-device extraction, running fully on this phone"
"Vision encoder (mmproj) always stays on CPU. Off = current CPU-only baseline."
"Applies to both -t and -tb. Default (4) matches this phone's fast cores; going higher pulls in the slow cores too and can be slower overall."

"Off = current behaviour: reloads the full model every run. On = keeps the model resident across runs and applies the vision-tile latency fix (~14-16s/field vs ~50-90s), but the first run after changing model/threads/GPU pays one restart cost."
"On (default): ~10-15s slower per run, but fixes real misreads found at 128 on clean cards (dropped/transposed letters, a wrong digit). Off = faster, only use once 128 has been re-validated."

"Cuts the PAN number / name / father / DOB regions out of the ORIGINAL photo and sends them as one 448x448 image (1 vision tile instead of 3). Expects a picture of the FRONT of the card only - crop it first. Saves the canvas as last_canvas.jpg next to run_log.txt."
